one_liner: Alperen Sengun records 6 assists per 36 minutes as a center, with 22.4 points and 10.6 rebounds beside it.
three_things: 6 assists per 36 from the pivot is the defining number in this line.
The scoring and rebounding are conventional big-man volume: 22.4 and 10.6 per 36.
The shooting is not part of the package: 28.2 percent from three, 69.3 percent from the line.
context_note: Per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not full-career figures. The manifest is descriptive_only: no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty, and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor applies. Games and minutes measure availability, not how well those minutes were used.
